headline: Big Tech and global financial risk
summary: The European Central Bank's Financial Stability Review identifies elevated valuations of AI-linked companies, including big tech, as one of three vulnerabilities in the financial system.
why: The ECB's Financial Stability Review assesses risks to the euro area financial system. Big tech valuations weigh heavily on major equity indexes and on investor exposure to AI.
original_headline: Big Tech y el riesgo financiero global
